stance: Crawler access discovery has shifted from general protocol compliance to granular, edge-level firewall bargaining where automated defense layers increasingly resist standard rule-making.
adoption_shape: Perplexity moved to unbundle its automated footprints into distinct IP ranges for PerplexityBot and Perplexity-User, whereas Cloudflare's platform-level Bot Fight Mode remains rigid and unalterable by custom publisher WAF overrides.
new_entrants: Perplexity is refining entry by establishing discrete routing for Perplexity-User alongside its primary bot, attempting to control site reach through Cloudflare Skip actions rather than simple Allow directives.
watch_for: Whether Cloudflare adapts Bot Fight Mode to permit targeted crawler rule exemptions or continues to enforce total bypass restrictions against AI retrieval agents.
